The '''alpharas flower''' was a rare variety of [[Flower/Legends|flower]] that bloomed only once every one hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]], and they could be found only on a small island in the middle of the [[Alkaline Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Durace]]. At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, an individual contracted a rare disease that could be cured by the alpharas flower, and a group of the individual's associates subsequently traveled to Durace in search of the flowers.<ref name="TUR" />
